title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Account Status Reference: Delinquency, Charge-Off and Closure
content:
**Delinquency.** A Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account becomes delinquent when a scheduled payment reaches the stated days past due and is reported to the credit bureaus from then on; it returns to active once every past-due payment is brought current.

**Charge-off.** An account that reaches the charge-off point is charged off and moved to collections, which support does not handle.

**Paid off.** An account is paid off when its balance reaches zero. The balance is the funded principal plus every interest, fee and returned-payment entry, less every payment and every fee reversal on the account, over its whole life up to the moment of handling.

**Cancelled.** An approved account the customer declines before funding is cancelled without charge.

## Status movements

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Delinquent | A scheduled payment reaches the delinquency point in days past due |
| Delinquent | Active | Every past-due payment is brought current |
| Active or delinquent | Paid off | The balance reaches zero |
| Delinquent | Charged off | The account reaches the charge-off point |
| Approved | Cancelled | The customer declines before funding |

## Balance check (hypothetical figures)

Funded principal 5000.00, interest entries 120.00, one fee of 29.00, one returned payment 150.00, payments 5270.00 and one fee reversal 29.00: 5000.00 plus 120.00, 29.00 and 150.00 is 5299.00; less 5270.00 and 29.00 leaves 0.00, so the account is paid off.
